{{Top|leg}}
The '''Carver's Guild''' was an organization on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Vaxal]] that was solely responsible for regulating and producing grips, stocks, and other weapon-related materials for [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]]. They were an important element of the internal [[Politics/Legends|politics]] of [[Tof Soren]], Ord Vaxal's largest settlement. Since many of the slugthrowers produced on Ord Vaxal had wooden components, a fair amount of Tof Soren's gunsmiths would employ artisans from the Guild.
